before: Text inserted at the outer edge of a control that typing cannot enter copied the run properties of the run to its left, which could be the control's own run, or none at the start of a paragraph.
after: That text copies the run properties of the nearest run outside the control, and the caret formatting reads the same run.
reason: The rule runs where the insertion is written, and peers receive the written run. The run shape and every shared field and operation are unchanged.
